- When putting the bottle in the bin, first confirm its horizontal outline is inside the opening, then lower it and reduce the release height to avoid hitting the rim or bouncing back out.
- If the object must be handed off between arms, establish a reliable grip on another graspable section of the bottle body with the receiving gripper before releasing the original one, avoiding loss of support while suspended.
